summary: Marti Technologies, Inc. filed a Form 6-K on April 27, 2026, announcing a new $2.5 million share repurchase program authorized by its board, valid until October 26, 2026. The program replaces a prior authorization and sets a ceiling price of $6.00 per share, with the stock at $2.11 as of April 24, 2026. Repurchases may be in open-market or negotiated transactions under Rule 10b-18; the board may extend or increase the program. Watch for execution pace and market reaction given the significant discount to ceiling price.
